scene.summary: Independent confirmation, airway and breathing re-check, and communication-access restore planning. Survival of the pulse is not the victory condition.

dialogue.speaker: Respiratory
dialogue.line: Reassess chest movement against the circuit. Do not invent replacement indication from readiness alone.

dialogue.speaker: AAC access specialist
dialogue.line: We restore access deliberately after rescue — device, switch, and low-stimulation setup.

clinicalTruth.airway: Still dependable after override; replacement remains gated.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Chest movement and circuit verification are active reassessment tasks.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Independent confirmation clears provisional uncertainty when recorded.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: Restore pathway is open; WAIT may return once questions are safe again.

visibleEvidence.label: Reassessment required
visibleEvidence.detail: Post-event checks are mandatory after provisional ROSC.

visibleEvidence.label: Circuit recheck
visibleEvidence.detail: External load and chest movement deserve another look now that rescue pressure eased.

hiddenState.primaryCause: Working interpretation may now surface external circuit load if evidence supports it.
notes: Cause language stays provisional and educational — not a dosing or settings tutorial.

communicationBeat.note: Restore access before opening new non-emergency questions.

familyBeat.note: Family may inform baseline communication preferences; they do not replace access specialists.

exitConditions.description: After reassessment tasks, restore AAC and family framing.
